description: Python source code implementing a video playback class 'VideoFFPy' using ffpyplayer, with setup instructions, threading, and OpenGL shader code for YUV to RGB conversion.

classes.name: VideoFFPy
classes.description: A Kivy video widget class that uses ffpyplayer for video decoding and rendering, supporting threading, OpenGL shader-based YUV to RGB conversion, and playback controls.

methods.name: _log_callback
methods.description: Logs messages from ffpyplayer with appropriate log level.

methods.name: unload
methods.description: Stops video playback, joins thread, and resets internal state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Unloads current video, preparing for new load.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts or resumes video playback, initializing ffpyplayer MediaPlayer and threading.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the video.

methods.name: _next_frame_run
methods.description: Thread target function that manages video frame retrieval, seeking, and dispatching frames to the main thread.

methods.name: _redraw
methods.description: Updates the texture with the current video frame, applying YUV to RGB conversion if needed.

methods.name: _finish_setup
methods.description: Finalizes player setup, applies volume and pause state.

methods.name: _do_eos
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream behavior based on 'eos' setting.
